hazards.evidence: Smooth white tub/shower floor with no visible non-slip mat or full anti-slip surface; wet acrylic tub floor is slippery.
Standard bathtub has a high side to step over; the seat is inside the tub rather than a transfer bench spanning the tub wall, so the user still must lift legs over the tub edge.
